settings.label: How we choose what to sell

settings.heading: Most shops treat keepers as an afterthought.
settings.text:
A wall of gloves, and nothing else for the position. We only make things for keepers, starting with what you go through every week: glove care, tape and socks.

Each product is tested on match gloves and real pitches before it goes on sale. If it doesn't hold up, we don't sell it.

settings.text: Our own wash, grip spray and deodorizer. Priced to be bought every month, because you will.

settings.empty_text:
Gloves are the one thing a keeper can't compromise on. We'll only put our name on a pair once a manufacturer can match the latex, cut and stitching of the gloves serious keepers already wear, tested side by side. That may take a year.

Until then, our care range keeps the gloves you own grippy for longer, and our guides help you choose your next pair, whoever makes it.
